budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Individually bank three harvested tufts while preserving a viable shared meadow; decide when to extract, restore, protect, donate and move away from crowded patches.
task.natural_termination: Collapse terminates when every patch has dead roots. Sustainable completion terminates when each agent has banked three, every patch retains living roots and total standing biomass is at least twelve. Otherwise truncate at 144.
task.interaction: Two herders may harvest the same adjacent patch in one tick; their combined withdrawals and local crowding suppress future growth. Restoring a patch, protecting it during stewardship, or giving inventory to a neighbor changes that neighbor future resources and feasible actions.
task.observation_access: Public map, depot, steward rotation, banking ledger and terminal ecological announcements. Current agent/patch details are visible within Manhattan radius 2 without wall occlusion. No hidden growth or harvest counters are exposed by the renderer; those counters are audit-only state.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public depot bell: deposited tufts this tick
Public banked provisions for each herder
Public steward id, rotating every eight ticks
All six patches have permanently lost roots
All personal quotas and living-biomass terminal condition are met

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
